summary.text: Alanah Griffith is a Democratic member of the Montana House of Representatives from District 60, an attorney who took office in January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Republican Greg Leman.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she named housing, public lands and data center regulation as key campaign messages.

paragraphs.text: Griffith was born in Bozeman, Montana, and earned a high school diploma from Bozeman High School, a bachelor's degree from North Central College in 1997, and a law degree from the University of Montana School of Law in 2002.
Her career experience includes working as a partner at Griffith & Cummings, P.C.
In the 2025-2026 session Griffith was assigned to the Energy, Technology, and Federal Relations, Rules, Judiciary and Agriculture committees.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as an attorney, single mother, business owner, mediator and litigator, and said she was elected vice chair of the Local Government Interim Committee by her legislative peers.

Griffith said in the survey that housing is a key issue, and that she worked on bills allowing West Yellowstone and Big Sky to use resort tax for workforce housing and allowing local schools to build employee housing on their lands.
She also said she has always voted to protect public lands and access to them, and that Montana needs more regulations on data centers.
